New to the Market
Bridget Cronin House – Exceptional 5 Bedroom Townhouse with Self-Contained 1 Bedroom Unit
Showhouse Condition | Town Centre Location | Turnkey Investment / Family Home

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to present Bridget Cronin House, a superbly renovated 5 bedroom townhouse with the added benefit of a self-contained one-bedroom unit.

This outstanding property comes to the market in pristine showhouse condition and offers a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious, high-spec residence in a prime town centre location. Finished to an exceptional standard throughout, the property is ideal for owner occupiers, investors, or those seeking multi-generational living.

Accommodation Comprises:
Ground Floor

Kitchen / Dining Room
Bright open-plan space featuring a breakfast counter, dining area, solid fuel stove, recessed lighting and timber flooring. Fully fitted with modern high-quality appliances.

Home Office
Timber flooring with fitted workspace and blinds — ideal for remote working.

Self-Contained One Bedroom Unit
(Perfect for granny flat, rental income or guest accommodation)
Open-plan kitchen / dining / living area with fitted kitchen and timber flooring
Patio door access to rear

Single bedroom with fitted curtains, blinds and flooring
Fully tiled bathroom with walk-in electric shower, vanity unit and WC

First Floor – Main Residence

Master Bedroom
Spacious double room with timber flooring, fitted blinds and curtains.
Ensuite
Fully tiled with vanity unit, mounted WC, heated towel rail and large walk-in pumped shower.

Bedroom 2
Single room with timber flooring and fitted storage.

Bedroom 3
Single room with timber flooring and feature lighting.

Main Bathroom
Finished to a high standard with standalone bath (mixer tap & shower), vanity unit, mounted WC, heated towel rail and large walk-in pumped shower.
Second Floor

Living Room / Playroom / Bedroom 5
Bright and versatile space with lino flooring and Velux skylight — ideal as an additional bedroom, living space or home office.

Features
Exceptional 5 bedroom townhouse with separate 1 bedroom unit
Presented in turnkey showhouse condition throughout
Ideal for family living, investment or multi-generational use
Oil fired central heating & solid fuel stove
Brand new PVC windows and doors
Large enclosed rear driveway with private parking and garden

Location
Located in a prime town centre setting, this property is within walking distance of all amenities including shops, schools, restaurants and transport links — offering convenience and lifestyle in equal measure.

Bridget Cronin House represents a rare opportunity to acquire a high-quality, versatile property in a central location with excellent potential.

Viewing strictly by appointment with the sole selling agents.
